It is compliant with IEEE 802.3cm, QSFP DD CIMS 4.0 and QSFP DD Hardware 5.1.

advanced-optical-modules-aoms.name: Advanced Optical Modules (AOMs)
advanced-optical-modules-aoms.description: From a dedicated Base-8 architecture to a standard 12 or 24 fiber system, Amphenol Network Solutions' Advanced Optical Modules (AOMs) offer the complete solution. Our AOM portfolio is easily configurable and adaptable to create a solution that meets your network needs. Modules are deployed in the C2X or C2E chassis.

c2x-fiber-distribution-panel.name: C2X Fiber Distribution Panel
c2x-fiber-distribution-panel.description: The C2X chassis' supports multiple patch, patch/splice, and pre-terminated fiber configurations available in either bulkhead or cassette solutions. C2X tray-based option accepts C2 AOMs (Advanced Optical Modules) for patch, patch/splice, as well as splitters, MPO breakouts, and WDMs. C2X is available in 1, 2, 3, or 4RU and supports vast fiber counts.
